# Git Diff Algorithms — myers, patience, histogram

## Thesis

`git diff` is not one algorithm. **myers** (default) is fast and good enough for most patches. **patience** and **histogram** spend more care on unique lines so moved blocks stay together in noisy files. This chapter diffs the same rewrite under all three. (The Argo CD book section on diff algorithms is about *rendered* app diffs — this chapter is everyday Git.)

## Mental model

```text
  git -c diff.algorithm=myers|patience|histogram diff
```

| Algorithm | Intent |
|-----------|--------|
| myers | Classic LCS-style; default |
| patience | Prefer unique lines as anchors |
| histogram | patience-like with histogram heuristics |

## Worked examples

Git on this box: **2.47.3**.

```
=== myers ===
diff --git a/f.txt b/f.txt
index e63706e..fc15405 100644
--- a/f.txt
+++ b/f.txt
@@ -1,10 +1,13 @@
 alpha
 bravo
-charlie
-delta
+CHANGED-1
+CHANGED-2
 echo
 foxtrot
 golf
+NEW-BLOCK-A
+NEW-BLOCK-B
+NEW-BLOCK-C
 hotel
 india
 juliet
=== patience ===
diff --git a/f.txt b/f.txt
index e63706e..fc15405 100644
--- a/f.txt
+++ b/f.txt
@@ -1,10 +1,13 @@
 alpha
 bravo
-charlie
-delta
+CHANGED-1
+CHANGED-2
 echo
 foxtrot
 golf
+NEW-BLOCK-A
+NEW-BLOCK-B
+NEW-BLOCK-C
 hotel
 india
 juliet
=== histogram ===
diff --git a/f.txt b/f.txt
index e63706e..fc15405 100644
--- a/f.txt
+++ b/f.txt
@@ -1,10 +1,13 @@
 alpha
 bravo
-charlie
-delta
+CHANGED-1
+CHANGED-2
 echo
 foxtrot
 golf
+NEW-BLOCK-A
+NEW-BLOCK-B
+NEW-BLOCK-C
 hotel
 india
 juliet
git version 2.47.3
```

On this small rewrite all three produced the same hunks — expected for a tidy change. Divergence shows up on large, copy-heavy files.

## Trap

**Changing `diff.algorithm` globally without telling the team.** Reviews suddenly look different.

## Boring rule

Leave myers for day-to-day. Switch to `histogram` when a review is hard to read because of moved blocks.

## Try this

1. Diff a file where a function moved 200 lines with all three algorithms.
2. Set `diff.algorithm` in a throwaway repo and re-run `git log -p`.
3. Read `git help config` under `diff.algorithm`.
